verdict.rationale: LangSmith's prebuilt per-project dashboards explicitly cover token usage, and custom dashboards can split data by run tag or metadata. Cost is tracked as an alertable metric, but the evidence never states that cost appears in the dashboards or breaks down per request, per model, or by time period. missing for 10: explicit cost charts in dashboards, documented per-request cost/token breakdown, per-model grouping, time-period views, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.
You can use group by run tag or metadata to split data over attributes that are important to your application.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
